value.signature: fn validate_registration_graph (graph : & RegistrationGraph , history : & ValidatedHistory , verifier : & impl RegistrationVerifier ,) -> Result < () , RegistrationError >

review.body: { let result = reconstruct (history , verifier) . and_then (| expected | compare_graph (graph , & expected)) ; if result . is_err () { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; } result }
review.item_premise: Registration operations consume immutable public records, diagnostic graph values and a declared deterministic public verifier. The verifier Debug and inputs contain public evidence only; no secret key or cryptographic implementation is admitted. Trace retains complete arguments and results, including refusals. Typed graph values are compared against reconstruction; serde bytes are diagnostic only and never canonical or binding equality. Observation supplies accounting only and never feeds computation. The shared typed comparator preserves the prior live-index, weight and endpoint checks; the public span and complete result remain unchanged. Registration and Affinity also reject protocol-reference fields their family blocks do not define, preserving the existing refusal accounting.
